high_level_description: A single full-body woman in a vibrant pink floral sundress and straw hat, bending slightly forward, centered on a 1600x900 canvas with pale sky above and grassy ground below.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Pale sky (#BBDEFB) covering upper ~85% of canvas; grassy ground (#4CAF50) as horizontal band at bottom ~13% (120px tall).

elements.desc: Head: light yellow circle (#FFEB3B), centered x=800, diameter 100px
Torso: rounded rectangle (#FF416C), width 160px, height 320px, slightly shifted left (x=720) to indicate bend
Straw hat crown: light yellow ellipse (#FFEB3B), centered over head, 40px wide × 20px tall
Hat brim: light yellow oval (#FFEB3B), 240px wide × 50px tall, centered horizontally, y-aligned just above head
Left leg: dark green rectangle (#2E7D32), 20px wide × 240px tall, aligned to left side of torso base
Right leg: dark green rectangle (#2E7D32), 20px wide × 240px tall, aligned to right side of torso base, slightly forward to show bend
Left arm: light green rectangle (#81C784), 20px wide × 200px tall, angled slightly forward from shoulder
Right arm: light green rectangle (#81C784), 20px wide × 200px tall, angled slightly forward and downward
Floral accent 1: pink circle (#E91E63), 20px diameter, on left side of torso
Floral accent 2: teal circle (#009688), 20px diameter, on center-torso
Floral accent 3: violet circle (#673AB7), 20px diameter, lower right torso
Floral accent 4: pink circle (#E91E63), 20px diameter, lower left torso
